hypotheses.D1_rotation_duplicates_roles: Random same-subspace rotations have at most 80% of the joint basis's effective first-role diversity at both layers.
hypotheses.D2_joint_roles_less_correlated: The joint basis has lower mean absolute pairwise first-role cosine than random same-subspace rotations at both layers.
hypotheses.D3_diversity_adjusted_cleanliness: The joint basis has higher first-role-energy times normalized role-diversity than random same-subspace rotations at both layers.
